gate: darksky.org presents a bot challenge to scripts; the survey does not get around bot checks, so DarkSky International's own register was not read. Wikidata's record is a partial mirror of it.
method: Items with P31 or P1435 among the classes above; one kind per item (sanctuary > reserve > park > community > urban > generic preserve); P625 coordinates.
caveats: Incomplete: Wikidata does not yet record every certified place; the true count is higher.
A point per place; reserves cover large areas.

reviewed_offshore.reason: Pitcairn Islands (a Dark Sky Sanctuary since 2019), too small for the 1:50m coastline; reviewed by hand 2026-11-06
